statement: TII is actively engaged in other initiatives, including extensive tree plantation projects, aimed at increasing carbon sequestration and promoting ecological balance within the communities where we are present.
40 lakh trees planted in FY 2024-25.

TII increased the share of renewable energy in total consumption from 48% to 60% in FY 2024-25, resulting in a CO2 reduction of 90,000 tonnes and an environmental impact equivalent to planting 40 lakh trees.

TII manufactured 1.5 million bicycles in FY 2024-25, representing a CO2 reduction of 7,11,750 tonnes compared to using diesel engines for similar transportation needs, equivalent to the environmental impact of planting 2.84 Crore trees.
One Million Tree Project To plant one million trees within the next five years, fostering environmental sustainability, biodiversity conservation, and community engagement.
This Initiative has been started at solid waste dump yard, Tharuvaikulam, Tuticorin from 2024-25.
During the year, efforts have been taken to set up Nursery, Fencing of the land, preparation of land, including clearing of bushes, digging trenches and setting up irrigation facilities.
The planting of saplings is in progress and so far nearly 4,500 saplings have been planted.
TII is committed to water conservation and responsible water management, implementing water-efficient practices and rainwater harvesting across its operations.
Supporting environmental and ecological balance through afforestation, soil conservation, rainwater harvesting, conservation of flora & fauna, and similar programmes
TII recognizes its responsibility to preserve and conserve fresh and clean water, striving to ensure sustainable water management practices across its operations.
TII has implemented Effluent Treatment Plants (ETPs) & Sewage treatment Plants (STPs) are employed to treat water discharged from manufacturing operations, enabling its reuse after proper treatment.
TII has implemented rainwater harvesting mechanisms across all its major business units to both utilize and recharge groundwater.
The company has adopted ISO 14001 standards and Company's environmental, health and safety (EHS) guidelines for its operations.
TII is committed to contributing to environmental preservation and ecological balance by undertaking sustained tree plantation activities
TII has set a target to plant 200,000 trees by 2030 as a measure to mitigate climate change and contribute to sustainable development
TII factories have environmental management system with operational control procedures to generate, handle, store and dispose hazardous and non-hazardous waste.

TII has registered with Central Pollution Control Board (CPCB) for plastics, e-waste and is in the process of registering for electric bicycle batteries. TII is working with CPCB authorized plastic waste processing entities to fulfil its EPR obligations.
All major plants are certified for ISO 14001 (Environmental Management Standards).
Local Communities: Environmental preservation
NGO Partners: Environmental preservation
Groundwater withdrawal for FY 2024-25 was 1,79,039 kilolitres and 2,08,492 kilolitres for FY 2023-24.
Rain water harvesting contributed 42,055 kilolitres to water withdrawal in FY 2024-25.

TII is a 100% Zero Liquid Discharge Company. All factories are equipped with effluent and sewage treatment plants for treating process effluents and sewage wastes. Effluent treated water is reused for operations and sewage treated water is used for gardening.
Retrofitting system installed in all DG for reducing the NOx, SOx and Particulate matter
TII has integrated the 3R principles (Reduce, Reuse & Recycle) into its waste management strategy to minimize environmental impact.
Across all business units, safe and effective waste handling practices are in place, supported by a robust Environmental Management System (EMS).
Operational control procedures for waste segregation, storage, and safe disposal.
Employee training to ensure proper identification and disposal of biodegradable, non-biodegradable, and hazardous waste.
Authorized waste handlers manage the recycling and co-processing of segregated waste.
Regulatory compliance – Hazardous waste authorizations are obtained from the State Pollution Control Boards to ensure safe and legal disposal.
Innovative waste reduction initiatives – e.g., Pedaling Dryer technology to reduce moisture in sludge waste, leading to lower hazardous waste output.
TII remains committed to enhancing circular economy practices and reducing its environmental footprint through continuous process improvements and sustainable waste management solutions.
TII adheres to the directions of the regulatory authorities towards use of ground water in areas where plants are located.
None of the operations/offices of TII are located in/around ecologically sensitive areas.
